card.name: Inside drug names, early syllables
card.fires_on: An early syllable partway through a drug or drug-class name, most often "iaz" in Thiazolidinediones or Thiazides. Also seen in polystyrene, isradipine and cefdinir.

modes.label: Thiazide class names
modes.description: The "iaz" piece after "Th" at the start of thiazolidinediones or thiazides.
